content.title: Echocardiographic and biomarker thresholds for diagnosing HFpEF (page extract)

parameters.Comments: Sensitivity 78%, specificity 59% for the presence of HFpEF by invasive exercise testing; a higher cut-off of 13 had lower sensitivity (46%) but higher specificity (86%).

parameters.Threshold: NT-proBNP: >125 pg/mL (sinus rhythm, SR) or >365 pg/mL (atrial fibrillation, AF); BNP: >35 pg/mL (SR) or >105 pg/mL (AF)
parameters.Comments: Up to 20% of patients with invasively proven HFpEF have natriuretic peptides below diagnostic thresholds, particularly in the presence of obesity.

parameters.Parameter: PA systolic pressure / TR velocity at rest
parameters.Comments: Sensitivity 54%, specificity 85% for the presence of HFpEF by invasive exercise testing.

parameters.Parameter: LV mass index / Relative wall thickness
parameters.Threshold: LV mass index ≥95 g/m2 (Female), ≥115 g/m2 (Male); Relative wall thickness >0.42
parameters.Comments: Although concentric LV remodelling or hypertrophy is supportive, the absence of LV hypertrophy does not exclude the diagnosis of HFpEF.

parameters.Threshold: >34 mL/m2 (sinus rhythm); in presence of AF threshold is >40 mL/m2
parameters.Comments: LA enlargement reflects chronically elevated LV filling pressure; thresholds differ if AF is present.

content.notes: Values and diagnostic performance derived from invasive exercise testing and referenced guideline data on page.

abbreviations.E/e' ratio: early filling velocity on transmitral Doppler / early relaxation velocity on tissue Doppler
abbreviations.HFpEF: heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
